# Sentiera Technologies Limited

> Masdar City AI venture studio. We build proprietary AI infrastructure and help GCC enterprises stay visible in AI answers. Strategy in Abu Dhabi. Engineering in Bangalore.

Canonical site: https://www.sentieratech.com

## Products

- [Cortex](https://www.sentieratech.com/cortex): AI visibility diagnostic. Enter a company URL and a target keyword.
- [Sourza](https://www.sentieratech.com/products/sourza): Autonomous B2B procurement marketplace connecting industrial manufacturing with GCC enterprise buyers.
